name: M. Dias Branco S.A. Indústria e Comércio de Alimentos
summary: M. Dias Branco S.A. Indústria e Comércio de Alimentos manufactures, distributes, and sells food products in Brazil. It offers cookies and crackers, pasta, and wheat flour/bran; vegetable shortenings and margarines, cakes, cake mixes, packaged toast, and snacks; and cereals, snacks, granolas, gluten-free products, seasonings, sauces, and condiments under the Adria, Aldente, Basilar, Bonsabor, Estrela, Fortaleza, Finna, Fit Food, Frontera, Isabela, Jasmine, Pelágio, Pilar, Piraquê, Predilleto, Richester, Salsito, Smart, Taste&Co, Treloso, Vitarella, Zabet, and Las Acacias brands.
